# Custom String

Source: [4590](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4590); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Custom String](../../api/values/custom-string.md).

<a id="wiki-4590-n1"></a>

- Custom String source/UI field limit is documented as 128 characters; runtime string limit is 511 bytes.

<a id="wiki-4590-n2"></a>

- Long strings can be nested/concatenated through placeholders; example uses 125-character chunks to leave room for {0}.

Source limitations:

- Character versus byte distinction matters for non-ASCII input; both numeric limits need version labeling.
